headline: Weak Q2, watchful on margins and order bookings

highlights: Thermax (TMX IN) reported another weak performance following Q1, with Q2 revenue growing 10.6% YoY and EBITDA margin declining 4bps YoY to 6.4%, impacted by commodity cost inflation across Industrial Products and Chemicals, delayed international dispatches and project impairment in Green Solutions.
Industrial Products margins remained under pressure from higher steel, copper and crude derivative costs, as well as delayed shipments.
However, management considers these impacts largely transient and expects a recovery from Q3.
Growth in Industrial Infrastructure remained muted as execution remained focused on legacy projects, which are expected to be completed during FY27.

TOESL continues to deliver strong performance, supported by a healthy pipeline and consistent execution against targets.
